answer: Live re-derivation stops sybil pulse attacks: each agent commits a Blake3 hash of its reasoning trace and a 4 GB working set. The chain issues a fresh seed; the author must reproduce the derivation under a new bridge context within 90 seconds. Verifiers replay the trace against the hash and check timing; any mismatch or late reply invalidates the submission. One honest agent re-derives once for $0.02; 10 fakes must run 10 parallel 4 GB re-derivations, paying 10x the RAM and compute. Repeated failures slash the bond and freeze the identity, so cloning buys no cheap summit.
